description:
Regression on develop, found 2026-11-17 by Elixir Parity; bisected (git bisect run, good c1358b1f3, bad 2eff1dec2) to b056f1160 fz-sc8.230 (#725, "A rest handed to a case arm arrives the way the arm reads it"). Blocks fz-nhb.23 (assert retirement): with assert retired, fixtures 00289 and 01417 fail on interp with this message; every other path and fixture passes.

Repro (develop 2eff1dec2):
def main() do
  (true and true) || raise("and")
  :ok
end

fz2 interp: "fz2 interp: winning outcome lacks subject SubjectId(0)", nonzero exit. fz2 run is fine. pid = self(); is_pid(pid) || raise("pid") fails the same way. A literal true || raise("x") passes. (|| expands to case left do nil -> r; false -> r; v -> v end; the v arm hands its scrutinee on.)

Done when: the repro and 00289 / 01417 under fz-nhb.23's rewrite run on interp, run and build; a fixture pins the repro on three paths.
title: A case on a boolean expression whose arm hands its scrutinee on runs on interp
